Bam Adebayo scored the Heat's first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 20 times in 74 starts, or 27% of the games they started. Andrew Wiggins was next with 14. The Heat made the game's first field goal in 57% of their 83 games and won 64% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
